stories.story_fr: Pour la premiere fois de son histoire, Lennox a livre des marges annuelles superieures a 20% en 2025, porte par les reductions de couts et un effet mix favorable.
stories.story_en: For the first time in its history, Lennox delivered annual margins over 20% in 2025, driven by cost reduction actions and mix benefits.
stories.signal: For the first time in its history, Lennox delivered annual margins over 20%, a particularly meaningful accomplishment driven by our cost reduction actions and mix benefits, said CEO, Alok Maskara.

stories.story_fr: L'integration de Duro Dyne et Supco renforce le portefeuille pieces et accessoires et a contribue pour 12% de croissance additionnelle au segment Building Climate Solutions au T1 2026.
stories.story_en: The integration of Duro Dyne and Supco strengthens the parts and accessories portfolio and contributed an additional 12% of growth to the Building Climate Solutions segment in Q1 2026.
stories.signal: The Building Climate Solutions segment delivered another strong quarter, with organic sales increasing 26% and acquisitions contributing an additional 12% of growth.

stories.story_fr: Le segment Home Comfort montre une amelioration sequentielle au T1 2026 : recul de 10% contre une baisse de 21% au T4 2025, le canal two-step se restockant avant l'ete.
stories.story_en: The Home Comfort segment shows sequential improvement in Q1 2026: down 10% versus a 21% decline in Q4 2025, as the two-step channel restocks ahead of summer.
stories.signal: While the segment experienced continued softness across both the one step and two step channels, this is a sequential improvement from the 21% decline in the fourth quarter.
